title: The bird on the lamp
logline: The bird on the green lamp's shade in the garage, September 2026, the lamp unlit, a page half-drawn under it on the table, the man's hand with the pen stopped. The page is the one being drawn; it has a bird on its lamp.

panels.composition: The drafting table under the unlit green lamp: the small rainbow bird perched on the lamp's shade, a half-drawn page beneath it, a man's hand holding a pen stopped mid-line at the frame's edge.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small rainbow bird perched on the shade of an unlit green swing-arm desk lamp above a drafting table with a half-drawn page and a man's hand holding a pen stopped mid-line at the edge, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: On the lamp. The pen stopped.
